## Tidyverse test

```{r}
#| label: fig-airquality
#| fig-cap: "Temperature and ozone level."
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

ggplot(airquality, aes(Temp, Ozone)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
```

## STATS19 test

```{r}
#| label: fig-sheff-ksi
#| fig-cap: "Sheffield KSI."
#| warning: false

library(stats19)

casualty = get_stats19(year = 2023, type = "casualty")

casualty |> 
  select(casualty_class, sex_of_casualty, age_of_casualty, casualty_severity) |> 
  slice_head(n = 6)
```
